plan.goal: Filter US counties to retain only contiguous United States counties by excluding Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, and other non-continental territories
plan.notes: Exclude non-contiguous territories using field STATEFP. Filter out STATEFP values: '02' (Alaska), '15' (Hawaii), '72' (Puerto Rico), and any other territory codes present. Retain all features where STATEFP is not in the excluded list. Preserve all original columns and geometry types (Polygon, MultiPolygon).
